class_mapping_audit.limitation: This validates the supplied text/JSON mapping algorithmically; the ONNX model file is absent, so output channel semantics are not independently verified.

calibration_validation_design.selection_rule: randomly shuffle images per category and take at most first 20 per category; union image IDs

preprocessing.resize: direct cv2.resize to 608x608; aspect ratio is not preserved
preprocessing.layout: CHW, with batch dimension per image

normal_image_false_alarm_rate.reason: The supplied person-only annotations contain 0 person-negative images; no FP counts or normal-image denominator.

quality_evidence.source_support: Static source shows a COCO bbox evaluation path, not completed accuracy results.

static_findings.finding: Recipe names COCO 2017 Train for calibration and COCO 2017 Val for evaluation. No materialized image lists or hashes establish the realized split or overlap.
Sampler uses random.shuffle without a recorded seed, takes up to 20 image IDs per category, unions them, and downloads them; no selected-ID manifest or calibration image hashes are supplied.

The 80 ONNX class names map uniquely to 80 COCO categories after six explicit aliases; person is output index 0 and COCO category ID 1. The ONNX model file is absent, so its output-channel semantics are not independently verified.

Supplied JSON has 2,693 distinct images and 11,004 person boxes; all 2,693 images have person annotations and no person-negative image is present. It cannot support an 80-class score or normal-image false-alarm rate.

Default execution branch selects yolov3-608 and direct 608x608 resize, BGR to RGB, float32/255, CHW. This differs from other preprocessing variants included in the source; input tensor metadata is not provided.
The recipe config enables both TensorRT FP16 and INT8 and evaluates a single model path; no separate FP32 baseline, pure INT8 artifact identity, predictions, or metric output is provided.
The example defaults to instances_val2017.json; the supplied file is instances_val2017_person.json with only category ID 1. The recipe does not explicitly bind the supplied subset.

Base YoloV3DataReader stores self.preprocess_func but load_serial/load_batches call unqualified preprocess_func; the supplied module does not define that global. Variant serial load uses self.preprocess_func; variant batch path again calls unqualified preprocess_func. No project Python was executed.
This is an external TensorRT quantization/evaluation recipe, not a training run or Zynq C/RTL/board deployment record. Those measurements remain unknown.
